basic_details.job_title: AMU CPC Assistant Professor (Computer Science) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Centre of Professional Courses, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh (AMU CPC), Uttar Pradesh, has invited applications for the post of Assistant Professor (Computer Science) under Advt No. 04/2026/CPC. Applications are accepted online until 29 November 2026.

application_fee.pwd_fee: Exempted, on uploading an authentic Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma
application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online mode at the Careers Portal only.

qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree with 55% marks in a concerned / relevant / allied subject plus NET / SLET / SET (Ph.D. holders as per UGC Regulations 2009 or 2016 exempted); OR Ph.D. from a foreign university ranked among the top 500 (QS / THE / ARWU).
qualification.details: Qualification: (A) i) A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned / relevant / allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university; (A) ii) Cleared NET conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET / SET; Ph.D. holders as per UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M. Phil / Ph. D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 are exempted from NET / SLET / SET; Ph.D. candidates registered prior to July 11, 2009 are exempted from NET / SLET / SET subject to five conditions (regular mode, two external examiners, open viva-voce, two research papers with one in a referred journal, two conference / seminar papers); OR (B) The Ph.D. degree has been obtained from a foreign university / institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by QS, THE or ARWU | Other conditions: | Open to Indian nationals, including OCI Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955 Qualifications, experience and other eligibility conditions reckoned as on the last date of submission of application form Relaxation in percentage of marks as per Government of India rules, wherever applicable

salary_details.pay_scale: Fixed salary of Rs. 30,000 per month

exam_pattern.details: No TA/DA will be paid for interview

how_to_apply: Fill the application form only in online mode at the Careers Portal https://careers.amuonline.ac.in by 29.11.2026.
Pay the non-refundable processing fee of Rs. 500/- online at the Careers Portal (PwD exempted with Disability Certificate).
Take a printout of the PDF of the submitted application form on A-4 size paper, sign it and paste a recent front-facing photograph.
Attach self-attested copies of the required documents.
Send the form by post, writing the post applied for, advertisement number and date on the top-left of the cover.
Hard copy to the Office of the Centre of Professional Courses, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh-202002 by 07.12.2026.
important_instructions: No separate interview letter will be issued Incomplete forms, applications on plain paper or without self-attested documents will be summarily rejected Separate application forms for each post under a different serial number Number of posts and salary may vary at the time of interview Selected applicants may be examined by an Internal Medical Board

content_sections.heading: AMU CPC Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 04/2026/CPC gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download AMU CPC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: (A) i) A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned / relevant / allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university; (A) ii) Cleared NET conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET / SET; Ph.D. holders as per UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M. Phil / Ph. D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 are exempted from NET / SLET / SET; Ph.D. candidates registered prior to July 11, 2009 are exempted from NET / SLET / SET subject to five conditions (regular mode, two external examiners, open viva-voce, two research papers with one in a referred journal, two conference / seminar papers); OR (B) The Ph.D. degree has been obtained from a foreign university / institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by QS, THE or ARWU Other conditions: Open to Indian nationals, including OCI Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955 Qualifications, experience and other eligibility conditions reckoned as on the last date of submission of application form Relaxation in percentage of marks as per Government of India rules, wherever applicable

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment purely temporary till the end of academic session 2026-2027 Liable to be terminated at any time without notice or assignment of reasons Post is to teach P.G. & UG level academic programs of multiple durations for Academic Session 2026-2027

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online mode at the Careers Portal only.

content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: High School & intermediate / Senior Secondary School Certificate from a Recognized Board Mark-sheet and Degree of Graduation Certificate of NET, JRF, SLET/SET, CSIR etc. as the case may be M. Phil / Ph.D. Degree wherever applicable Experience Certificates wherever applicable

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No separate interview letter will be issued Incomplete forms, applications on plain paper or without self-attested documents will be summarily rejected Separate application forms for each post under a different serial number Number of posts and salary may vary at the time of interview Selected applicants may be examined by an Internal Medical Board
